module_convention: free left modules; rows; coefficients multiply boundary rows on the left

encoding.word: signed generator indices 1,...,5; empty word is 1
encoding.polynomial: list of [nonzero integer coefficient, reduced word], sorted by (length,word)
encoding.matrix: list of source-generator rows; each row is a list of polynomials

ideal_membership_recipe.ideal_term: n*u*(r_i-1)*v; u,v are reduced free words; n is an integer
ideal_membership_recipe.product_derivative: Fox(p*f)=Fox(p)+p*Fox(f); retain p until proved p=1
ideal_membership_recipe.proof_storage: Reconstruct sparse ideal terms deterministically using this recipe, the six factorizations, and verify.py; expand every equality in Z[F5]. No stored success flags or scalar/matrix specializations are accepted.

scope: Exact integral identities over the six-relator group ring, without a group-word solver.
Both torsion identities are derived, not assumed or added as ideal generators.
Explicit filling chains, cycle orientations, retraction, projection, and contraction.
No geometric sphere maps, topological realization, Lean certification, independent review, or novelty claim.
